script:
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$p=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'EasyCV-Downloads-20261102-Chrome\ChromeStandaloneSetupARM64.exe'
$s=Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $p
if($s.Status -ne 'Valid' -or $s.SignerCertificate.Subject -notmatch 'O=Google LLC'){throw 'Installer signature not trusted'}
$child=Start-Process -FilePath $p -ArgumentList '/silent','/install' -PassThru
@{installerPID=$child.Id;source='Google official ARM64 installer';signatureStatus=[string]$s.Status;scope='new Windows test VM; no browser policy/profile edits';installationComplete=$false} | ConvertTo-Json
stdout:

    "scope":  "new Windows test VM; no browser policy/profile edits",

    "source":  "Google official ARM64 installer",
    "signatureStatus":  "Valid"
}
